description: A point directly before an exponent is read as part of the number
notes: The grammar requires a digit after the point, so the spec reads 1.e5 as the literal 1 followed by the attribute access .e5. The reference scanner's NumberLit rule in hclsyntax/scan_tokens.rl accepts any run of digits, points and exponents that doesn't end in a point, and cty.ParseNumberVal (math/big's ParseFloat) accepts "1.e5" as 100000.
